name: Provinciaal Arbeidsplaatsen Register (PAR) 2024
licence: Public Domain Mark 1.0 per georegister metadata
access: open, form-based download; WFS disallowed to automated agents by robots.txt
notes: Acquired by the author's hand download. Settles the contradiction of S06-015: the open file is establishment-level but anonymous — point location (RD, EPSG:28992), size class code, SBI hierarchy, start date, municipality, place, business-park code (RIN), parent-company country (MOEDERLAND, filled for 2,554 rows) and a circular-economy tag. No name, KVK number or address. Titled 2024, but the content is the 1 April 2022 register (S06-043). Size class codes undocumented (S06-045).

name: Brookz business-for-sale listings
access: website; manual only, scraping presumed against terms
notes: About 1,100 national listings. Listing fields unverified. Proposed guard, not yet ruled: never match anonymised listings to named register entries.

name: OpenStreetMap, Geofabrik Utrecht province extract
notes: Acquired by the author's hand download (Geofabrik blocked to both proxies). 17,279 named business features extracted; 70% with website, 85% with postcode and house number, 3 with a KvK tag. Opens epoch 2.
